target.title: Bounded agent context recovery and continuation
target.summary: Reduce uncached input by recovering verified task state from one project brief and one exact read.
target.content: Use a revision probe before spawning a coordinator or worker. New workers receive a bounded continuation packet, not full conversation or transcript history. Passive immutable task snapshots and retention storage never assign, approve, or execute tasks. A project brief binds the current task head and returns a delta only for its exact predecessor; otherwise it returns a snapshot. A handoff receipt proves recorded bytes, not receiver acceptance. Integrated access routes through the Nexus remote gateway, while standalone Cortex uses local IPC with no network listener. Recovery exports are readable, but an exact database backup remains distinct. Unchanged heartbeat cycles are deterministic and make no model or worker call; changed delivery requires an acknowledgement-backed outbox. Resume solved work from verified closeout evidence, revision-checked state, and bounded context budgets.
